title: India solvency-flag back-test (pre-registered, survivorship-free, FY2016/FY2018): no flag clears the graded-red bar; S5-India 1.985x and S1 2.2x match the US but are underpowered; S3 stays out
body: 489 company-snapshots (NSE/BSE non-financial, Rs 200-20,000 cr at T=30-Sep-2016/2018, standalone screener annual data cut at FY0; stratified: distress-list census D 177 rows, delisted sample X 5, live sample L 307, weighted). 5-year O_fail = IBBI liquidation (19) or compulsory exit (29) or weekly close <=0.2x (165) = 168 rows, weighted base 19.7% (US 9.5%). Pooled lift [stratified company bootstrap]: S1 2.20 [0.50,4.42] (13 fired, winners lost 1.4%); S2 1.69 [1.27,2.20] (20% of >=3x winners lost); S2b 1.68; S4 0.76; S5-India 1.985 [1.01,3.24] (3.8% winners lost, recall 7%); S3-US 1.29 (flags 50% of firms, 63% of winners); S3-India (cash+investments credit) 1.15 [0.85,1.50]; S0 loss-maker 1.12. Verdict by the fixed rule: all QUESTION, nothing hard. US graded-red pair is consistent but not proven in India (power). Weak interest cover is a real Indian signal beyond losses (O_strict lift 2.87) but costs a fifth of multibaggers. CIRP admission != failure (14 of 79 admitted rows did not fail). Survivorship: 83-85% of IBBI firms retrievable on screener; renamed/merged IBC firms (Bhushan Steel, Monnet) and 221 identifier-less IBBI rows lost. Deviations: unlabeled dead banks removed (fix), ~1 minute of two fetch streams. Research, not SEBI-registered advice.

data.universe: NSE/BSE non-financial, Rs 200-20,000 cr mcap at T, standalone screener pages, live+dead

verdicts.S1: QUESTION (lift 2.20, CI [0.50,4.42] includes 1; only 13 flagged rows)
verdicts.S3_US: stays excluded (1.29; flags 50% of firms, 63% of winners)

data.unlocks: calibrated India solvency gate decision (keep S1/S5 as graded red on US evidence or demote to question); next power boost: add FY2014/FY2020 snapshots or full L/X census

title: India solvency back-test FY2016/18: S1 negative net worth -> QUESTION (lift 2.20, CI 0.50-4.42; only 13 flagged rows) - same size as US, underpowered
body: Negative net worth (equity capital + reserves) is rare among Rs 200-20,000 cr Indian companies (1.4% weighted). 7 of 13 flagged rows failed (43% vs 19.7% base); excludes 2 of 92 >=3x winners. One in three S1 firms entered CIRP within 5 years (33.5% vs 3.6%). Examples caught: ABG Shipyard, GTL, Jet Airways, McNally Bharat, Indosolar. Payout exemption never applied. Not refuted - not enough cases.

title: India solvency back-test FY2016/18: S2 interest cover <1.5x -> QUESTION (lift 1.69 [1.27,2.20]; 2.87 on liquidation/exit) but cuts 20% of multibaggers; <2.5x variant no better
body: Fires on 19% of the frame; precision 32% vs 19.7% base; recall 32%. Unlike the US, not just a loss-maker proxy (S0 EBIT<0 alone lift 1.12 in India). Strongest broad Indian signal for liquidation/compulsory exit (O_strict lift 2.87 [1.88,4.11]). Excludes 20 of 91 >=3x winners -> deep-dive question, not a gate. S2b (<2.5x) lift 1.68, flags 32% of firms and 35% of winners.

title: India solvency back-test FY2016/18: S4 dividends > FCF while debt rose -> no signal (lift 0.76; FY2018 0.44) - fails in both US and India
body: 89 of 487 rows flagged; dividend payers failed less than base. Excludes 25% of >=3x winners. Drop as a solvency flag candidate in both markets (keep only as a component of S5 by the live definition until decided).

title: India solvency back-test FY2016/18: S5-India (>=2 of S1,S2,S4) -> QUESTION, borderline (lift 1.985 [1.01,3.24], winners lost 3.8%, recall 7%)
body: 25 of 489 rows flagged, 14 failed (39% vs 19.7%). Misses the pre-registered graded-red bar (lift >= 2.0) by 0.015; CI lower bound barely above 1. Per snapshot 2.08 (FY2016) / 1.88 (FY2018). S5b (S2b in place of S2) 1.82 [1.07,2.70], winners lost 7.4%. S5-US (incl. S3) 1.27. Consistent with US graded-red S5 (2.37) but not proven in India.

title: India solvency back-test FY2016/18: S3 short-term funding gap stays out of India S5 - US version flags 50% of firms (lift 1.29); India variant with investments credit no better (1.15)
body: US S3 (STD > cash + 0.5 CFO): 272 of 469 flagged, lift 1.29 [1.09,1.50], excludes 63% of >=3x winners. Exploratory S3-India (STD > cash + balance-sheet investments + 0.5 CFO): 174 flagged, lift 1.15 [0.85,1.50] on O_fail, 1.86 [1.25,2.55] on O_strict, excludes 47% of winners. Supports decision:india-solvency-s3-excluded. Standalone investments include subsidiary stakes, a known weakness of the variant.
